model_output:
```sql
WITH jefferson_county AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Jefferson County' AND border_type = 'county'
),
nature_reserves AS (
  SELECT id, park_name, geometry
  FROM parks
  WHERE leisure = 'nature reserve' AND ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM jefferson_county))
),
biggest_reserve AS (
  SELECT park_name, geometry
  FROM nature_reserves
  ORDER BY ST_Area(geometry::geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  br.park_name AS reserve_name,
  MAX(rast_value) AS highest_elevation
FROM biggest_reserve br
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, 1, br.geometry::geometry, TRUE))).max AS rast_value
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, br.geometry::geometry)
) sub;
```
